a-vault-under-mount-fictus-1971: Two people say that in 1971 a vault was dug beneath Mount Fictus, a fictional mountain. Cy Fixture, who describes himself as one of the crew, says he helped dig it; Eve Fixture, a researcher on a podcast, says she read the same in the mine's own records. Bo Fixture, a harbour pilot, repeats what Cy told him. If true, it would mean somebody wanted something hidden under the mountain and had the means to do it.
the-plains-of-elsewhere-hum-at-night: A podcast host, Dee Fixture, and a researcher, Eve Fixture, both say that the plains of Elsewhere, a fictional place, give off a low hum at night that nobody has explained. Neither says they heard it themselves, and no document is named.
a-crate-in-the-vault-opened-by-itself-19: Cy Fixture, who says he was one of the crew digging a vault under Mount Fictus in 1971, says a crate down there opened by itself one night. Nobody else tells this.
the-harbour-light-was-a-weather-balloon-: A guest on a podcast, Bo Fixture, says the light seen over the fictional Harbour of Nowhere in 1958 was a weather balloon catching the evening sun. He tells it as the simple explanation of the lantern story.
the-lantern-over-the-harbour-of-nowhere-: Bo Fixture, a harbour pilot, says that one evening in 1958 a lantern-like light hung over the Harbour of Nowhere, a fictional port, for about an hour. He says he saw it himself from his boat.
the-lanterns-are-a-mirror-1957: Cy Fixture, a researcher, says the lights people call lanterns, seen over the fictional Harbour of Nowhere since 1957, are a mirror: a reflection of the town's own lights off the water. He gives no source beyond his own reading.
the-ring-in-the-ice-of-lake-placeholder-: Fay Fixture says that in the winter of 1980 a perfect ring melted into the ice of Lake Placeholder, a fictional lake, and that nobody could say what made it. Gus Fixture repeats her account on another show.
the-vault-crew-was-sent-away: Cy Fixture, who says he dug a vault under Mount Fictus, says the whole crew was sent away before the work was finished and told not to speak of it. Nobody else tells this.
